hooks.command: changes=$(git status --porcelain -- lib test 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$changes" ]; then powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tool/verify.ps1; code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "tool/verify.ps1 e fallito (architettura, flutter analyze o flutter test). Continua a correggere finche non e verde, poi rilancialo prima di fermarti."}'; fi; fi
